pairs.question: Vt vales?
pairs.derivation: Sagaristio asks 'ut vales?' (line 42); Toxilus answers 'Vt queo.' (the speech tag TOX. dropped, first word capitalized). The answer stops at the full stop before Sagaristio's next question 'Quid agitur?'.

pairs.question: Quid agitur?
pairs.derivation: Sagaristio asks 'Quid agitur?' and Toxilus answers 'Vivitur.' (line 42). Speech tag TOX. dropped; answer is a single word, full stop kept.

pairs.question: Satin ergo ex sententia?
pairs.derivation: Sagaristio asks whether things are satisfactory; Toxilus answers conditionally (line 43). Speech tags SAG./TOX. dropped. Answer ends at its full stop before Sagaristio's 'Nimis stulte amicis utere.'

pairs.question: Sed hoc me unum excruciat. Quidnam id est?
pairs.answer: Haec dies summa hodie est, mea amica sitne libera, an sempiternam servitutem serviat.
pairs.derivation: Toxilus' setup 'Sed hoc me unum excruciat' is kept (verbatim) so 'id' has a referent; Sagaristio's interrogative 'Quidnam id est?' follows (line 61). Toxilus' reply (lines 62-63) genuinely answers what torments him; the answer ends at the full stop before Sagaristio's 'Quid nunc vis ergo?'. Speech tags dropped.

pairs.question: Metuis, ne te vendam?
pairs.derivation: Saturio's question 'metuis, ne te vendam?' (line 430); the dangling interjection 'Quid?' is dropped as framing and the first word capitalized. Virgo answers 'Non metuo, pater.'; the answer stops at the full stop before her continuation 'verum insimulari nolo.' Speech tags SAT./VIR. dropped.

pairs.question: Futura es dicto oboediens an non patri?
pairs.derivation: Saturio's alternative question (line 451); Virgo answers 'Futura.' (line 452). Speech tags dropped, single-word answer with full stop kept; the answer stops before Saturio's next question 'Scis iam tibi quae praecepi?'.

pairs.question: Scis iam tibi quae praecepi?
pairs.derivation: Saturio asks whether she knows what he taught (line 452); Virgo answers 'Omnia.' Speech tags dropped. Answer stops before Saturio's next question 'Et ut surrupta fueris?'.

pairs.question: Vbi tu nata es?
pairs.answer: Vt mihi mater dixit, in culina, in angulo ad laevam manum.
pairs.derivation: Dordalus asks 'Vbi tu nata es?' (line 721); Virgo answers with the joke about the kitchen (lines 721-722). The inline verse number 630 dangling mid-line is stripped. Speech tags DOR./VIR. dropped; answer ends at its full stop.
